messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: p99 tail latency spike for customer LumenHealth on prod-redwood-us-east-1. Severity: S2. Link: https://incidents.internal/1748003210 @elena on-call.
elena: I'm on it, joining the call.
elena: Quick snapshot: p95 steady ~180ms, p99 jumping to 2.8s for streaming endpoints. Customer reporting streaming stalls + disconnects.
raj: I'm seeing spike correlated with long prompt prefixes (~15-22k tokens) — single-tenant LumenHealth. Likely KV-cache thrash on dedicated-7 pool.
simon: Runtime logs show repeated KV cache evictions at 14:03:12 UTC. Tail requests hit cold KV and sometimes fall back to CPU decode path.
kaitlyn: Customer's timeline: bulk data import at 13:59, then first stall reported at 14:02. They sent logs showing repeated reconnects.
elena: Mitigation plan: 1) enable model-variant fallback to quantized v2 for the LumenHealth route, 2) increase tenant KV size on dedicated pool, 3) temporary autoscale. Raj, can you flip routing policy canary?
raj: Starting canary: /routes/lumenhealth -> model redwood/gpt-large-q2 at 14:12 UTC. Command used:
```
curl -X POST https://control.internal/routes/route-123/fallback -d '{\"variant\":\"gpt-large-q2\",\"pct\":15}'
```
incident-bot: Deploy-bot: Canary change applied (15%) by raj at 14:13 UTC.
simon: Increasing prefix-KV allocation for tenant lumenhealth on pool dedicated-7 to 1.5G. Command:
```
rctl set-kv --pool dedicated-7 --tenant lumenhealth --size 1.5G
```
kaitlyn: Notifying customer: sending ETA 10-15m and asking them to temporarily raise streaming timeout.
elena: Monitoring metrics: 14:14 p99 -> 2.2s, 14:18 -> 1.1s. Trend looks positive. Keep canary at 15% until 14:30 and observe.
support-bot: Ticket LUM-487 updated with mitigation steps and temporary routing changes.
raj: Added one GPU to dedicated-7 (temp autoscale) to relieve eviction churn. Command: `autoscale --pool dedicated-7 --add-gpu 1 --reason "lumenhealth tail spike"`
simon: Observed client-side connection resets when server delays exceed ~3s — looks like client timeouts amplify apparent stalls. Recommend customer raise streaming client timeout to 10-12s.
elena: Decision: if p99 <1.5s for 10m, rollout to 50% at 14:30; if p99 <=1.2s then 100% and clear page.
kaitlyn: Customer confirmed they increased client timeout to 12s and saw fewer disconnects :thumbsup:.
incident-bot: STATUS UPDATE: Mitigation in progress. P99 trending down. Next update scheduled 14:30 UTC.
raj: Follow-ups: add eviction metrics alert, tune KV eviction thresholds, per-tenant prefix histograms. Assign to eng-runtime for action items.
elena: Handoff to night oncall simon at 16:00 UTC — simon please own postmortem and customer writeup if stable.
simon: Ack, will collect traces and prepare RCA draft. Starting trace collection now.
kaitlyn: Recommendation: add docs for large-prefix handling for dedicated customers; include guidance on timeouts and kv sizing.
elena: Closing note: keep monitoring for 2 hours after full rollout. Great team response, nice work everyone. :clap:
